parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of data to return in the current call. Default to be 1 and allowed input is from 1 - 5000.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Use the 'page_size' filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). Default to be 20 and allowed input is from 1- 100.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status filter for retrieving voucher list. Available value: upcoming/ongoing/expired/all.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: voucher_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The list of voucher.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: voucher_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The unique identifier for a voucher.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: voucher_code
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Voucher Code

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: voucher_name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Voucher Name

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: voucher_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The type of the voucher. The available values are: 1: shop voucher, 2: product voucher.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reward_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The reward type of the voucher. The available values are: 1: fix_amount voucher, 2: discount_percentage voucher, 3: coin_cashback voucher.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: usage_quantity
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The number of times for this particular voucher could be used.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: current_usage
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Up till now, how many times has this particular voucher already been used.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: start_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The timing from when the voucher is valid; so buyer is allowed to claim and to use.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: end_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The timing until when the voucher is still valid. Any time after this end_time, buyer is not allowed to claim or to use.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_admin
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: If the voucher is created by Shopee or not.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: voucher_purpose
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The use case for the voucher. The available values are: 0: normal; 1: welcome, 2: referral; 3: shop_follow; 4:shop_game, 5: free_gift, 6: membership

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: discount_amount
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The discount amount set for this particular voucher. Only when it is a fix amount voucher, api will return a value.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: percentage
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The discount percentage set for this particular voucher. Only when it is a discount percentage voucher or coins cashback voucher, api will return a value.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: cmt_voucher_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The voucher status in CMT. The available values are: 1:review, 2: approved, 3:reject. Only when this voucher is attending CMT campaign and not being rejected, api will return a value.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: display_start_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The timing of when voucher is displayed on shop pages; so buyer is allowed to claim.
